enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Stretch legs. Yawn. Resume sleeping. Turn to back. Sigh. Pull blanket down. Turn to left side. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing schedule and preparing for the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Enter Bedroom 2. Sit at desk. Check calendar. Stand up. Walk to closet. Open closet. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Greet Member 1. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Place eggs on plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Talk with Member 1. Place plate in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking emails and planning work tasks on computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email client. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Schedule meetings. Open task manager. Create task list. Prioritize tasks. Close email. Open document. Write notes. Save document. Check phone. Send message. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Continue planning.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on arts administration tasks on computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open project file. Review budget spreadsheet. Enter data. Calculate totals. Open grant application. Fill out form. Save file. Send email to colleague. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Open document. Write report. Edit report. Save report. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get glass of water. Return to desk. Continue work.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing arts administration work and planning freelance illustration tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Open illustration project. Sketch ideas on paper. Scan sketch. Open digital art software. Create new canvas. Draw outline. Adjust layers. Save file. Open email. Check client messages. Reply to client. Open calendar. Schedule illustration time. Close software. Open administration document. Review notes. Save document. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Greet Member 1. Open refrigerator. Take out sandwich ingredients. Slice bread. Spread butter. Add cheese. Add lettuce. Place on plate. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Place plate in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work and freelance illustration projects on computer and monitor
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Open monitor. Open illustration software. Work on commission. Draw lines. Color areas. Adjust shading. Save file. Open email. Check messages. Reply to client. Open administration task. Update spreadsheet. Save. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Use toilet. Wash hands. Return to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Wrapping up work and organizing notes
enriched_activities.desc: Save all open files. Close software. Shut down computer. Turn off monitor. Pick up notebook. Review notes. Write summary. Close notebook. Organize desk. Stand up. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Greet Member 1. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Select channel. Watch TV. Talk with Member 1. Pick up phone. Check social media. Put down phone. Adjust volume. Change channel. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Return to couch. Eat snack. Turn off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating dinner with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Greet Member 1. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Add meat. Add vegetables. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Place plate in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up after dinner with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up dishes from table. Carry to sink. Scrape food into trash. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counter with sponge. Sweep floor. Empty dustpan into trash. Wipe table with cloth. Walk to living room with Member 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on freelance illustration commissions using computer and monitor
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Turn on monitor. Open illustration software. Open commission file. Sketch new ideas. Draw lines. Color. Add shadows. Save file. Open email. Check client feedback. Reply to client. Make revisions. Save file. Open second commission. Work on it. Save. Close files. Shut down computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening hygiene routine and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Wash hands. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Wash face. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Put on pajamas. Walk to bedroom.
Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping.
